title: IBM MQ — Overview (pack SLIs)
description: IBM MQ pack SLIs, the last certification's MTTD/MTTR, error-budget burn and the signals behind them.

options.content:
### IBM MQ · Overview
The eight pack SLIs at a glance, the last certification's MTTD and MTTR, and the signals behind them.  ·  pack `ibmmq@0.2.0`  ·  [Unified](/d/ibmmq-unified?${__url_time_range}) · **Overview** · [Queues & channels](/d/ibmmq-queues?${__url_time_range}) · [SLO burn](/d/ibmmq-slo-burn?${__url_time_range})

panels.title: Process up
panels.description: 5-minute fraction of scrapes in which the queue manager's native metrics endpoint answered. SLO 99.9 % over 30 d.

panels.title: Reachable
panels.description: 5-minute fraction of samples in which an MQ client (the exporter over DEV.ADMIN.SVRCONN) saw the queue manager RUNNING. Diverges from "process up" on listener, channel, CHLAUTH or CONNAUTH faults.

panels.title: Queue headroom
panels.description: Highest depth / MAXDEPTH across application queues. 100 % means producers get MQRC_Q_FULL (2053).

panels.title: Oldest message
panels.description: Age of the oldest message on any application queue (DLQ excluded). Consumer health.

panels.title: DLQ depth
panels.description: Messages on the queue manager's dead-letter queue (APP.DLQ).

panels.title: Canary success
panels.description: 5-minute success ratio of the synthetic put→get probe on APP.CANARY (matching payload within 5 s).

panels.title: Canary p99
panels.description: p99 put→get round-trip of successful probes over 5 minutes (connect time excluded).

panels.title: Log write latency
panels.description: Recovery-log write latency reported by the queue manager. Persistent-message throughput depends on it.

panels.title: Last certification
panels.description: Verdict of the last `npm run certify` published to the alert-sink: PASS, WARN, FAIL or ERROR.

panels.title: Certified
panels.description: When the last certification run finished.

panels.title: MTTD p50
panels.description: Median time from fault injection to the alert webhook, across every expected alert of the chaos suite. Baseline p50 1 min (pack spec.baselines).

panels.title: MTTD p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to detect. Baseline p95 2 min.

panels.title: MTTR p50 · resolution
panels.description: Median time from the recovery action to the resolved webhook: the observability system's share of MTTR (it excludes the human/automation fix time). Baseline MTTR p50 15 min.

panels.title: Symptom alerts firing
panels.description: Symptom alerts currently firing (burn-rate and forecast alerts excluded).

targets.expr: count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", pack="ibmmq", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open connections to the queue manager (client view).

panels.title: Symptom alerts · pending / firing
panels.description: State of every symptom alert of the pack over the time range.

targets.expr: (2 * max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="firing", burn_rate="", kind=""})) or max by (alertname) (ALERTS{pack="ibmmq", alertstate="pending", burn_rate="", kind=""}) or label_replace(vector(0), "alertname", "no alert", "", "")

panels.title: Queue manager log
panels.description: MQ console log (AMQ message id + text), parsed by the collector.
